title: A red paid run keeps no traces to find its cause
what: When a paid eval run is red, the transcripts of its failing runs are kept (the eval tool's --keep-temp or a copy of the failing runs' folders into ~/.relay), so the cause can be read instead of guessed; green runs keep nothing extra.
why: 26 Oct: the paid run at 13ea53b was red; for design-track run 3 (no thinker started, 5 steps, 18 s) the cause could not be established because bin/ci does not pass --keep-temp and the traces were deleted; three candidate causes stay unverified.
failing_case: After the red paid run of 26 Oct (record ~/.relay/evals/relay/2026-10-26T01-47-23Z-master.json) no transcript of design-track run 3 exists.
pass_cases: A red run leaves the failing runs' transcripts at a path the record names; a green run leaves none.
where: bin/ci how it calls the eval tool (no --keep-temp)
